Maya L: Heads-up 1: OrbitEdge and Redwood planning a joint benchmark run next week focused on throughput-per-watt and kernel tweaks. Need a short checklist and owners.
OrbitEdge (Partner): We can supply 3 nodes (Ampere-like), firmware v2.3.3, and DC power meters. Want to test 150W / 250W / 320W targets and a final unthrottled run.
Jared K: I'll own the bench harness. Proposed workload: redwood-chat-quantized load with seq=1024 typical, bursty tail at 2048. Clients=128, sustained 6h per power point.
Nina S: Add kernel tuning matrix: SMT on/off, numa balancing on/off, and our recommended io_uring patch. We should capture nvml + ipmi + powermon.
Vikram P: For accuracy checks: use validation prompts set bench/edge/semantic-2000. We'll checksum token outputs to ensure quantization parity.
Maya L: Marketing wants a short embargo timeline: initial internal report within 48h of test completion, partner-approved deck in 72h, public post (if green) after signoff.
OrbitEdge (Partner): Legal: we'll need an MoU for aggregated telemetry sharing and joint PR approval. Can your legal draft?
Maya L: Yes, I'll loop legal. @alice-bot can you create a ticket in partnerships/bench with attached artifact bucket?
alice-bot: Created ticket #P-BENCH-4521 and S3 prefix s3://redwood-bench/orbitedge/3640010022. Logs auto-upload in CI.
Jared K: Example run command (will commit to repo):
```
runbench --suite edge-throughput --model redwood-4xq --commit abc123def --seq 1024 \
  --clients 128 --duration 6h --power 150,250,320 --batching adaptive --check-sums yes
```
Nina S: Also capture `perf record -e cpu-clock,branches,branch-misses -a` and `nvprof` for GPU kernels. We'll need kernel oops logs if any.
OrbitEdge (Partner): We'll provide chassis-level thermal maps and per-server wall-meter CSVs. Expect setup window Tue 06:00 PT.
Vikram P: I'll prepare the normalization script to compute tok/s/W and a weighted average across seq lengths. Will post the notebook link.
Maya L: Outline of owners: Jared = bench runs & scripts; OrbitEdge = hardware & power logs; Vikram = analysis & normalization; Nina = kernel matrix; Maya = comms/legal.
Jared K: Spinning a smoke run now, CI id bench-orbit/smoke/3640010022.
alice-bot: CI smoke passed 1: baseline throughput 1.6k tok/s at 150W. Artifacts: https://ci.redwood.internal/bench-orbit/3640010022/logs
OrbitEdge (Partner): Looks promising. We'll reserve Wed/Thu for the full sweep.
Maya L: Perfect. Please drop any roadblocks here. If all good, target partner preview next Friday. :white_check_mark:
